faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.text: Quick answers about projects, collaboration, talks and XR development.
items: What kind of projects do you build?
I work on XR experiences, medical visualization, interactive prototypes, technical demos and digital products for health, research and education.
Yes. You can contact me for professional collaborations, research, community initiatives, talks or projects where immersive technology has a clear purpose.
Do you work with Unity and WebXR?
Yes. I use Unity, C#, Three.js and WebXR depending on the project goal, target device and interaction needs.
Can you prepare a technical demo?
Yes. I can build demos to validate an idea, present a concept, explain a complex flow or turn technical content and data into a visual experience.
Do you give talks or workshops?
Yes. I can join talks, workshops and outreach sessions about XR, programming, innovation, digital health and medical visualization.
Usually we start with a short conversation to understand goals, audience, scope and available material. Then we define a clear proposal and next steps.
